latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Generate Japanese-localized videos from your clips using cloud GPUs.

- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB for video localization into Japanese.
- Seamless backend connection with automatic session management; handles both authenticated and anonymous users.
- Provides video dubbing, on-screen Japanese text, BGM editing, and export to 1080p MP4.
- Real-time cloud processing with updates, status polling, and error handling for common issues.
- Key workflows include single/iterative video edits and batch processing, optimized for short clips (<2 min).
- User-friendly prompts and mapped actions for uploading, editing, checking credits, and downloading results.
